description: MobiData BW publishes a service that checks GTFS Schedule feeds and exposes validator results as monitoring metrics. Its README shows how to run the container, supply public feed URLs through a Prometheus multi-target probe and scrape the resulting metrics. The service uses the official MobilityData GTFS validator and reports through Prometheus or OpenTelemetry; it is licensed EUPL-1.2. It does not itself provide route or timetable data. A user supplies a feed URL, so geographic and temporal coverage come from that feed. The repository includes a container build and tests, but this review only inspected the README and file tree. It did not run the service or test the stated metrics against a real feed. A transport modeller could use the quality signal before importing timetables, and monitor whether a regularly refreshed feed begins to fail validation. That role is input checking, not route simulation. Related catalogue resource data-gtfs-specification defines the format that the service checks. Its metrics should be interpreted alongside the validator’s rule set and cannot establish whether schedules match actual operation.
name: GTFS validator metrics service
